turn: The "Partner API keys" step is finished. I added a test in src/partners/keys.test.js that issues a key with issueKey() and asserts that hashOf(key) equals the hash returned alongside it, so a stored hash can be trusted to match the key the partner receives. I wrote the test but haven't run it, so I can't tell you whether it passes. In the same commit I made one small fix I noticed along the way. The partner key test file was missing a trailing newline, and I added it so editors and diffs stop flagging that file. Next I'll start "Nightly CSV feed for partners".

sidefix.title: Add missing trailing newline in test
sidefix.what: Added the missing trailing newline at the end of src/partners/keys.test.js so diffs and editors no longer flag the file.
